units.english: This plant seems to be of some significance to the Mereti. Bring the plant and two Wanderer 'mentors' to <destination> so that the Wanderers can try to work out how to make it grow.
units.italian: Questa pianta sembra avere una qualche importanza per i Mereti. Porta la pianta e due 'mentori' Wanderer a <destination>, così che i Wanderer possano provare a capire come farla crescere.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|The Mereti have clearly been expanding their greenhouses since you last visited this world. A few smaller drones gather around as your ship comes in to land, and they welcome you as you step out.|26|0
units.english: The Mereti have clearly been expanding their greenhouses since you last visited this world. A few smaller drones gather around as your ship comes in to land, and they welcome you as you step out.
units.italian: I Mereti hanno chiaramente ampliato le loro serre da quando hai visitato l'ultima volta questo mondo. Qualche drone più piccolo si raduna mentre la tua nave atterra, e ti danno il benvenuto quando scendi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	Then, without giving you time to properly respond, they shepherd you into one particular greenhouse, slightly larger than the others. Within, a single plant sits in a majestic pot in the center, illuminated by a shaft of light through the windows above. It is small, with vibrant deep blue petals and teal leaves, and despite your lack of familiarity with it you can tell that it is not growing well.|27|0
units.english: Then, without giving you time to properly respond, they shepherd you into one particular greenhouse, slightly larger than the others. Within, a single plant sits in a majestic pot in the center, illuminated by a shaft of light through the windows above. It is small, with vibrant deep blue petals and teal leaves, and despite your lack of familiarity with it you can tell that it is not growing well.
units.italian: Poi, senza darti il tempo di rispondere come si deve, ti accompagnano in una serra in particolare, un po' più grande delle altre. Dentro, una sola pianta sta in un vaso imponente al centro, illuminata da un fascio di luce che scende dalle finestre in alto. È piccola, con petali vibranti di blu intenso e foglie verde acqua, e anche se non la conosci riesci a capire che non sta crescendo bene.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	One of the drones speaks to you, much more quietly than the last time you spoke with them. "You are our friend. You helped to [defend, protect] us when we were attacked. You brought our [parents? ancestors?] to us. Please, help us again."|28|0
units.english: One of the drones speaks to you, much more quietly than the last time you spoke with them. "You are our friend. You helped to [defend, protect] us when we were attacked. You brought our [parents? ancestors?] to us. Please, help us again."
units.italian: Uno dei droni ti parla, molto più piano dell'ultima volta che avete parlato. "Tu sei nostro amico. Ci hai aiutato a [difenderci, proteggerci] quando siamo stati attaccati. Ci hai portato i nostri [genitori? antenati?]. Ti preghiamo, aiutaci ancora."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	"I will help you."|30|0
mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	"What do you need me to do?"|31|0
units.english: "What do you need me to do?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	The drone speaks again. "This plant is important to us. It is our..." The drone pauses for a few seconds, and lights flash across it. "It is important to us. Our [teachers, mentors] say it is not [native, local] to this world, and cannot survive here." As it says this, two Wanderers walk in accompanied by another Mereti drone, talking with each other in hushed tones. They look up when the drone you are speaking with mentions them, and quickly approach you.|32|0
units.english: The drone speaks again. "This plant is important to us. It is our..." The drone pauses for a few seconds, and lights flash across it. "It is important to us. Our [teachers, mentors] say it is not [native, local] to this world, and cannot survive here." As it says this, two Wanderers walk in accompanied by another Mereti drone, talking with each other in hushed tones. They look up when the drone you are speaking with mentions them, and quickly approach you.
units.italian: Il drone parla di nuovo. "Questa pianta è importante per noi. È la nostra..." Il drone si ferma per qualche secondo, e delle luci gli lampeggiano addosso. "È importante per noi. I nostri [insegnanti, mentori] dicono che non è [nativa, originaria] di questo mondo, e che qui non può sopravvivere." Mentre lo dice, entrano due Wanderer accompagnati da un altro drone Mereti, che parlano fra loro a voce bassa. Alzano lo sguardo quando il drone con cui stai parlando li nomina, e ti si avvicinano in fretta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	"Can you help them?"|34|0
mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	"What should we do?"|35|0

mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	One of the Wanderers speaks up. "This plant... it shares crucial similarities with some of the plants that we [grow, tend] on <planet>, so let us bring it there for now. There will be [differences, complications], but that is the [best, most likely] [approach, solution] in the short term. But we still seek to leave these worlds to the Unfettered, and so we cannot [house, cultivate] this plant there forever."|36|0
units.english: One of the Wanderers speaks up. "This plant... it shares crucial similarities with some of the plants that we [grow, tend] on <planet>, so let us bring it there for now. There will be [differences, complications], but that is the [best, most likely] [approach, solution] in the short term. But we still seek to leave these worlds to the Unfettered, and so we cannot [house, cultivate] this plant there forever."
units.italian: Uno dei Wanderer prende la parola. "Questa pianta... ha somiglianze cruciali con alcune delle piante che [coltiviamo, curiamo] su <planet>, quindi portiamola lì per ora. Ci saranno [differenze, complicazioni], ma è il [migliore, più probabile] [piano, approccio] nel breve periodo. Però vogliamo comunque lasciare questi mondi agli Slegati, quindi non possiamo [ospitare, coltivare] questa pianta lì per sempre."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|	The drones, which have been silently listening to the two Wanderers, carefully pick up the pot containing the plant, and fly back in the direction of your ship, followed by the two Wanderers. You follow them back and prepare to set off for <planet>.|37|0
units.english: The drones, which have been silently listening to the two Wanderers, carefully pick up the pot containing the plant, and fly back in the direction of your ship, followed by the two Wanderers. You follow them back and prepare to set off for <planet>.
units.italian: I droni, che hanno ascoltato in silenzio i due Wanderer, sollevano con cura il vaso con la pianta e volano verso la tua nave, seguiti dai due Wanderer. Li segui e ti prepari a partire per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1|The Mereti ships following you caused some alarm among the local population as you came in to land, particularly with the spaceport's traffic control, who are unaccustomed to the way they hurtle by less than a meter from the Wanderers' ships at almost top speed on their way down.|41|0
units.english: The Mereti ships following you caused some alarm among the local population as you came in to land, particularly with the spaceport's traffic control, who are unaccustomed to the way they hurtle by less than a meter from the Wanderers' ships at almost top speed on their way down.
units.italian: Le navi Mereti che ti seguivano hanno destato un certo allarme fra la popolazione locale mentre atterravi, soprattutto nel controllo del traffico dello spazioporto, che non è abituato al modo in cui sfrecciano a meno di un metro dalle navi dei Wanderer a velocità quasi massima durante la discesa.
